messages:
Erin (CS): quick sync — OlivCo dedicated pool goes live tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final quota + autoscale plan, and a short smoke run to prime caches.
Sam (Solutions): got it. target capacity = 3x A500s, expected sustained = 1k qps, peak = 5k qps for short bursts. suggest autoscale policy below.
Maya (SRE): share the autoscaler knobs you want — we prefer conservative scale-up to avoid overshoot.
Sam (Solutions): proposed autoscaler: target_util=0.7, scale_up_step=1, scale_up_cooldown=60s, scale_down_step=1, scale_down_cooldown=300s. Also enable burst buffer of +1 node for 10m.
Diego (Infra): noted. We'll reserve the burst node but need quota approval for the extra GPU token. Erin, do we have billing OK?
Erin (CS): finance signed the reserved commit last week, quota for burst approved up to +2 GPUs for 1h.
Olivia (Customer PM): thank you. Also want the smoke to validate tail latency < 200ms for interactive routes and token cost baseline.
Maya (SRE): we'll collect p50/p95/p99 and token-rate telemetry. Add a canary route that hits the cached prefix to validate KV priming.
Sam (Solutions): suggested priming steps (short):
```bash
# prime KV cache and prefix for common prompts
for f in primes/*.json; do curl -s -X POST \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d @${f} https://dedicated.redwood.internal/v1/generate; done
```
This should warm the kv cache and compile kernels used by the model.
Diego (Infra): also run an embeddings batch to pre-warm batch queue:
```bash
python tools/embed_batch.py --file sample-utterances.csv --batch-size 64 --endpoint /v1/embeddings
```
Erin (CS): smoke test window 09:00-11:00 PT. Can we run a progressive ramp: 100 -> 500 -> 1k -> 3k -> 5k (15m each)?
Maya (SRE): yes. We'll monitor autoscale events and put an alert if scale actions exceed 4 in 30m.
Sam (Solutions): load test script (locust) for the plan:
```text
locust -f tests/oliv_smoke.py --users 1500 --spawn-rate 100 --run-time 1h
```
This will hit both chat and embeddings routes with a 70/30 split.
Olivia (Customer PM): can we stub slow downstreams? OlivCo has an external DB for retrievals that can add variance.
Diego (Infra): we can set a simulated latency layer in front of retrieval endpoints in staging to match prod-ish behavior.
Erin (CS): checklist before 09:00:
- Confirm reserved GPUs allocated (Diego)
- Autoscale policy applied (Maya)
- Billing/quota for burst verified (Erin)
- Priming scripts executed 30m before start (Sam)
- Customer on standby for run (Olivia)
Sam (Solutions): I'll run priming at 08:30 PT and post outputs here. Expect kernel compile logs (~5-7m) and KV hits ramp.
deploy-bot: canary deploy to dedicated pool succeeded: revision r-2026-03-19-8ac3
Maya (SRE): after smoke we'll snapshot traces and perf baseline. If tail latency > 250ms at p99 we abort and rollback to fallback model.
Olivia (Customer PM): that's fine. We'll have product folks watch UX during smoke.
Erin (CS): perfect. I'll update the playbook and send calendar invite. @Sam @Maya please ack when autoscaler and priming are ready. :thumbsup:
Sam (Solutions): ack. Priming plan in place.
Maya (SRE): ack. Autoscaler policy will be live at 08:45 PT.
Erin (CS): thanks all — closing thread, will post post-mortem notes in #customer-success after the run. :rocket:
